main_text.p: ut opinari fe fcribit, obfervatum fit, dolores enim matri, & lactis penuriam feu defectum facere ; aft, mi Borelli inquit D. Strauff. five Exod. 23. v. 19. ... five Deut. 14 v. 21. in quo eadem plane verba repetuntur, (velut item Exod. 34. v. 26.) quae feptuaginta ita explicue- runt, ... penitius infpicias, videbis, inquit, nihil effe quod ate vifum putas. Uterque enim textus faltem innuit, inquit, lactantem non coquendum effe haedulum: Aliud autem eft, inquit, lactantem haedulum coquere; aliud haedulum in lacte coquere. Haec D. Strauff. qui an ipfae fenfum loci recte fuerit affe- cutus, dubito: Certe lactantem haedulum coqui, fimpliciter effe vetitum non opinor. Declarari videtur fenfus fupe- rior loco alio qui eft Levit. 22. v. 27. Ubi Deus ita loquitur: Bos, vel agnus, vel capra, cum natus fuerit, & fuerit fep- tem diebus fub matre fua, & a die octavo & deinde.

page.notes: Several Hebrew and Greek passages are printed in the text (the Hebrew of Exod. 23:19 and Deut. 14:21 and the Greek of Exod. 34:26) and could not be reliably transcribed; they are shown as ellipses above and should be checked against the scan. The marginal note on the right edge is too faint to read and is not transcribed.
